overview: Identifies the ranking achievements that a battle or PvE run can award to a player.

None.technical: Default value of FGameDataTableRow_RankingRecord::RankingRecord and FGameDataTableRow_CharacterSpecialAttack::RankingRecord. Ranking widget initialization fills its key array with zero, casts those keys to this enum, misses the label map, and displays SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0021.

SendDamage.simple: Dealing a large amount of damage in one battle.
SendDamage.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent Attack_Damage log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 1000 damage.

ReceiveDamage.simple: Enduring a large amount of damage in one battle.
ReceiveDamage.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total received Attack_Damage log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 1000 damage.

AceAttacker.simple: Defeating several opponents in one battle.
AceAttacker.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent Dead log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 3 defeats.

FirstDown.simple: Scoring the first defeat of the battle.
FirstDown.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords awards this value when GetFirstKillCharacter() returns the player character. This case takes no PrizeThreshold input.

CursedEnergyCharge.simple: Building a large amount of Cursed Energy experience.
CursedEnergyCharge.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent CursedEnergy_Exp log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 900 experience points.

CursedEnergySense.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent CursedEnergyAttack_Count log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 20 attacks.

Jammer.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent Debuff log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 3 debuffs.

TurboDash.simple: Spending a large amount of dash gauge.
TurboDash.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent DashGauge log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 9000 gauge points. The log stores the gauge lost when a dash starts or continues.

JustGuard.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total received JustGuard log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 3 guards. The English label resolves to Perfect Guard.

DomainExpansionMania.technical: Declared and mapped to BTL_RANKING_LABEL_0010. The available export gives this value a ranking row with a threshold. EvaluateRankingRecords has no matching case, so no award rule is traced.

GuardBreak.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent GuardBreak log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 1 guard break.

OverwhelmingBattle.simple: Winning with the whole team still intact.
OverwhelmingBattle.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords awards this value when PlayerBonuses contains EGameResultScore::OverwhelmingWin. That bonus is created for the winner while time remains or is unlimited and the winner's current stock equals the stock maximum.

Finisher.simple: Delivering the finishing moment of a battle.
Finisher.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords awards this value when PlayerBonuses contains EGameResultScore::Finisher. That bonus is created when FocusActor848 equals the character.

Runner.simple: Covering the most ground in a battle.
Runner.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords awards this value when PlayerBonuses contains EGameResultScore::Runner. The Runner bonus is added from a positive total sent MovedDistance value and is removed from every character except the farthest mover.

SpecialTagCombo.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent SpecialTagCombo_Hit log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 2 hits. The English label is Joint Attack.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: Landing a Super Cursed Energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 1 hit. The English label is Awakening.

LongShooter.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent AttackRange_Long log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 25 attacks. The English label is Sniper.

ShortHitter.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords finds the player's total sent AttackRange_Short log and awards this value when it reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 25 attacks. The English label is Up Close.

Scorer.simple: Finishing with a high result rank.
Scorer.technical: EvaluateRankingRecords awards this value when the supplied result Rank is at least the row PrizeThreshold of 4.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack_01.simple: The Four Black Flashes ranking record for Yuji Itadori.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_01.technical: Character-specific super-attack record. The available export assigns it to CP_010, whose display name is Yuji Itadori, and the UI label resolves to Four Black Flashes. EvaluateRankingRecords awards it when the cached special-attack row for the player's character carries this value and the total sent SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit reaches the row's PrizeThreshold of 1 hit.

NoRecovery.simple: Avoiding recovery during a PvE run.
NoRecovery.technical: CountRankingRecords finds the ranking row with this value and adds one record when PvESettings.NoRecoveryCount reaches its PrizeThreshold of 2. The tally then stores the count under the enum byte in the user record map.

BindingVowsWelcome.simple: Taking on several Binding Vows during a PvE run.
BindingVowsWelcome.technical: CountRankingRecords finds the ranking row with this value and adds one record when PvESettings.BindingVowCountTotal reaches its PrizeThreshold of 6. The tally then stores the count under the enum byte in the user record map.

CursedSpiritsHunter.simple: Clearing a PvE run against cursed spirits.
CursedSpiritsHunter.technical: CountRankingRecords adds one record under this enum byte when MissionKind equals 1. The tally selects this value directly and does not read the row threshold.

BossKiller.simple: Clearing a PvE run against a boss.
BossKiller.technical: CountRankingRecords adds one record under this enum byte when MissionKind has any value other than 1. The tally selects this value directly and does not read the row threshold.

AnnihilationKing.simple: Defeating many enemies across a PvE run.
AnnihilationKing.technical: CountRankingRecords sums Value434 from every battle result into DefeatedCount and adds one record under this enum byte when that total reaches the row PrizeThreshold of 3 defeated enemies.

Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 sentinel value 255. It has no ranking row and no label-map entry. If it reaches the evaluator, the switch default awards nothing, and no explicit consumer was found.

notes: The evaluator casts each awarded enum value to uint8 and stores it in the battle result record bytes.
The PvE tally later uses those bytes as user record map keys, and the ranking widget casts keys back to this enum for label lookup.
Thresholds quoted here are the PrizeThreshold values in the supplied RankingRecordDataTable export. The source comparison uses Row->PrizeThreshold.

Character identities and numbered super-attack labels come from the supplied CharacterSpecialAttack, Character, BattleText, and GlossaryText exports. The source stores only the enum value on FGameDataTableRow_CharacterSpecialAttack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_17 is shared by CP_051 and the ST_CP_051 mission variant.
